id: title:benjackwhite:survive goaway on idle grpc connections

review.posthog_relevance: Usage ingestion reliability and diagnostics. P1.F2.H3 adds retryable error codes and exponential backoff, while P1.F2.H2 adds a counter for records sent. This could preserve records during transient transport failures and help diagnose ingestion success.
review.reason: Adds retryable error codes and backoff, and a retry counter. P1.F2.H3 adds Code.Canceled and Code.Internal to RETRYABLE_CODES, and P1.F3.H1 adds a backoff delay and a retry counter. P1.F3.H1 also changes the retry condition to allow retries up to MAX_ATTEMPTS. P1.F3.H1 also records the retry in a counter.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of retry and counter mechanisms, which supports ingestion reliability. However, the actual benefit of these changes, such as the reduction in record loss or the diagnostic value of the counter, is not independently verified and could not be established without further testing or production data. No tier assignment is not a 1

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is requested, so no score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds retryable error codes and backoff, and a retry counter. P1.F2.H2 adds Code.Canceled and Code.Internal to RETRYABLE_CODES, and P1.F3.H1 adds a backoff delay and a retry counter. P1.F3.H1 also changes the retry condition to allow retries up to MAX_ATTEMPTS. P1.F3.H1 also records the retry in a counter.
observations.posthog_connection: Usage ingestion client now retries transient transport failures and records retries. This could preserve records that would otherwise be lost if a connection is torn down mid-flight, and could prevent record loss during connection churn.

observations.behavior: Adds a counter for records sent. P1.F2.H1 adds a counter for records sent.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a counter for records sent. This could help track ingestion success and failure, and could help diagnose ingestion issues.
